title: Flower Golems
description: Adds 6 unique flower-themed textures for Iron Golems (including 1 ultra-rare). Requires OptiFine or ETF.
body:
# 🌸 Flower Golems (Random & Custom Textures)
Tired of the same old look for Iron Golems? This resource pack introduces **6 unique flower-themed textures** that distribute randomly among spawned golems. Each variant is beautifully inspired by Minecraft's flora!

---

### ⚠️ IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT
This pack **DOES NOT WORK** in pure vanilla Minecraft. To enable random textures and nametag triggers, you **MUST** use one of the following:
* **OptiFine** (make sure "Random Entities" is enabled in your Video Settings)
* OR **Entity Texture Features (ETF)** mod (highly recommended for Fabric / NeoForge / Quilt)

---

### 🌿 Golem Variants & Nametag Triggers:
You can let them spawn naturally in your world, or force a specific variant by renaming a golem using a **Name Tag**:

1. **Oxeye Daisy** — A clean, classic white and yellow look. `[Nametag: daisy]`
2. **Cornflower** — Vibrant blue with soft violet undertones. `[Nametag: cornflower]`
3. **Poppy** — Fiery, rich scarlet red accentuating the golem's power. `[Nametag: poppy]`
4. **Dandelion** — Warm, sunny yellow tones inspired by a blooming meadow. `[Nametag: dandelion]`
5. **Lavender** — A calm, magical purple/lilac shade. `[Nametag: lavender]`
6. **✨ Multi-Flower ✨** — **ULTRA-RARE SECRET!** Combines all flowers on a single body. Has only a ~2% chance to spawn naturally (10x rarer than others)! `[Nametag: multi]`
